description: Run one queued or scheduled task now, skipping its clean window. Use when: the user wants the result now. Do not use for a failed task (use retry_task), to pick a new deadline (use update_deadline), or for a claude-code task (run `tidegap queue run-now <id>`). Behavior: drops its earliest start and makes one provider call at the current grid intensity; needs the task provider's key in the server env (and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY); the receipt records intensitySource=expedited. Returns: status and error on failure. Rejects running, submitted, finished and unknown tasks.

task_id.description: Id of the queued or scheduled task to run now, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the schedule_task reply or the check_queue_status list.

name: expedite_task
